) center/100% 100% no-repeat;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 10px 32px rgba(72,27,124,.12)}
button,input{font:inherit}
button{touch-action:manipulation}
.game{user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none}
input{user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.hit{position:absolute;border:0;background:transparent;padding:0;margin:0;cursor:pointer;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;outline:none}
.hit:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(106,40,217,.45);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:10px}
#lines{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;z-index:3}
.word-hit,.pic-hit{z-index:4}
.word-hit.selected{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(139,92,246,.26) inset;border-radius:13px}
.fill{position:absolute;z-index:5;border:0;outline:0;background:transparent;color:#111;text-align:center;font-weight:800;padding:0;caret-color:#6b28d9;font-size:clamp(17px,2vw,32px);line-height:1}
.fill.filled{background:#fff}
.fill.good{color:#209843}
.fill.bad{color:#d43c3c}
.reveal{position:absolute;z-index:5;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:transparent;overflow:visible;pointer-events:none;padding:.32%;}
.reveal.show{display:flex}
.reveal img{display:block;width:auto;height:auto;max-width:72%;max-height:72%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center center;margin:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 1px 1px rgba(80,50,110,.08));}
.translation{position:absolute;z-index:5;border:0!important;outline:0;background:transparent!important;color:#2f1d55;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(14px,1.45vw,24px);padding:0 2px;line-height:1.1;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none}
.translation:focus{background:rgba(255,255,255,.5)!important}
.translation.good{color:#209843}
.translation.bad{color:#c83434}
.spy-check{position:absolute;z-index:6;background:transparent;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none}
.spy-check.on::after{content:'✓';position:absolute;inset:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#252525;font-weight:900;font-size:clamp(15px,1.35vw,22px);line-height:1}
.spy-object{position:absolute;z-index:5;background:transparent;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none}
.control{position:absolute;z-index:6;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;outline:0!important;padding:0;cursor:pointer;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none}
.control:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(106,40,217,.45)!important;outline-offset:-4px!important;border-radius:18px}
.toast{position:absolute;z-index:20;left:50%;bottom:1.2%;transform:translate(-50%,16px);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(100,43,190,.94);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(11px,1.1cqw,18px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.2s;white-space:nowrap;max-width:82%;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media(max-width:720px){body{padding:0}.game{border-radius:0}}
@media(orientation:portrait) and (max-width:800px){body::before{content:'Поверните телефон горизонтально ↻';position:fixed;z-index:99;left:50%;top:8px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:rgba(78,35,139,.92);color:#fff;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:12px;pointer-events:none}}


50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(255,214,64,.45)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(255,214,64,0)}}

.spy-object:focus-visible{outline:2px dashed rgba(107,40,217,.55);outline-offset:1px;border-radius:8px}
/* REVISION: stable inline inputs for task 2 */
.fillword{position:absolute;z-index:7;background:transparent;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-start;gap:.03em;color:#111;font-weight:800;font-size:clamp(14px,2.05cqw,32px);line-height:1;height:4.8%;padding:0 .25%;box-shadow:none;}
.fillword input{width:.82em;height:1.18em;border:0;border-bottom:2px solid #222;background:transparent;outline:0;text-align:center;color:#111;font:inherit;font-weight:800;line-height:1;padding:0;border-radius:0;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;caret-color:#6b28d9;box-shadow:none}
.fillword input:focus{border-bottom-color:#6b28d9;background:#fbf8ff}
.fillword input.good{color:#209843;border-bottom-color:#209843}
.fillword input.bad{color:#d43c3c;border-bottom-color:#d43c3c}
/* REVISION: translation fields aligned to the actual printed lines */
.translation2{position:absolute;z-index:7;border:0!important;outline:0;background:transparent!important;color:#2f1d55;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(11px,1.40cqw,22px);height:2.9%;padding:0 .15%;line-height:1.12;appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none!important;caret-color:#6b28d9}
.translation2:focus{background:rgba(255,255,255,.30)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 -2px 0 rgba(107,40,217,.55)!important}
.translation2.good{color:#209843}
.translation2.bad{color:#c83434}
/* Keep reveal images clean inside the dashed frame */
.reveal{border-radius:4px}
.reveal img{max-width:94%;max-height:94%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
/* Task 5 check mark stays entirely inside the source checkbox */
.spy-check.on::after{font-size:clamp(10px,1.05cqw,17px)}


/* === AESTHETIC POLISH === */
.game{font-family:"Trebuchet MS","Arial Rounded MT Bold",Arial,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 18px 42px rgba(76,34,132,.16);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden}
.word-hit,.pic-hit,.pron-hit,.spy-check,.spy-object,.control{transition:box-shadow .16s ease,background-color .16s ease,transform .12s ease,opacity .16s ease}
.word-hit:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(118,72,201,.14);border-radius:13px}
.word-hit.selected{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(118,72,201,.28),0 3px 12px rgba(92,49,160,.10);border-radius:13px}
.pic-hit:hover{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(118,72,201,.10);border-radius:14px}
.pron-hit:hover{background:rgba(115,66,201,.035);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(115,66,201,.10);border-radius:15px}
.control:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.14);border-radius:18px}
.control:active,.pron-hit:active,.word-hit:active,.pic-hit:active{transform:scale(.992)}

/* Task 2: print-like typography; success is quiet, not neon */
.fillword{font-family:"Trebuchet MS","Arial Rounded MT Bold"
